title: 🚨STOP! 5 Job Search Scams That Could Cost You $$$!
description:
“Job seekers, don’t get ripped off! Scammers are targeting your resume, emails, and interviews. In this video, I break down the top 5 scams to avoid immediately:

1 Fake ATS scores
2 Fiverr resume ‘fixers’
3 Personal Gmail/Yahoo recruiter emails
4 Weird interview platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, FB Messenger)
5 Anyone asking for money upfront

Watch this NOW to protect yourself and your career. Like, share, and subscribe @kirchnercareers for more real, free job search tips that actually work.

online training: https://katekirchner.thinkific.com/products/courses/resume-and-cover-letter-writing-course

#JobSearchScams #CareerTips #ResumeTips #JobSeekers #AvoidScams
transcript: Stop. Job search scams are everywhere right now. Here's what to avoid immediately. The first one is the fake ATS score. If someone tells you your resume failed the employer's ATS score and you need to pay them to fix it, scam. The ATS doesn't even work like that. The second one is the Fiverr ré fixers. Once you get the fake ATS score message, then comes the email saying that someone on Fiverr or at a Gmail address can magically fix the ATS score. and then the job is yours. Nope. Scam. The third one is personal email addresses. If a recruiter contacts you from a Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, anything that's not a company domain, it is fake. Real recruiters don't hire from personal email addresses. Or if it is from a company domain, it is maybe misspelled by one or two letters. So look very closely to verify it is truly coming from the company. The fourth one is weird interview platforms. interviews on WhatsApp, Telegram, or Facebook Messenger. Automatic no. Professional companies do not hire through chat apps. This is the kicker. The one I want you to really avoid. Never pay upfront. If anyone asks for money upfront to apply, interview, onboard, or train, immediate scam, walk away. Share this so someone else doesn't get ripped off. And be sure to subscribe at Kersner Careers for practical job search tips that will help you get hired and won't cost you a scent.
